content: Mumwiigwe Taatabhugya
Eriihi ne eriiyoge bhiri gati weenyu, bhirareetwa naki? Ndora bhirareetwa ne eziinaamba zino zikuhigana muusi weenyu.

Muriigoomba ebhigiro ebhingʼania, na, hano mukubhurwa, mwiibhanwiiri kwiita. Muragwaatwa no omugono kubhya abhaatu, na mutana nzira yo okubhibhona, muriitana no okwiiyogenia. Na bhino mukweenda, mutakubhibhona kwo okubha mutakubhisabha ku Taatabhugya.
Naabhe mukumusabha mutakubhona kwo okubha muramusabha kwe enzira embiihu, okubha mubhone kino mukweenda kwe eziinaamba zyeenyu.

Emwe ni bhaatu bhano mutana obhuheene ku Taatabhugya, kya abhaseebheeti. Mutamenyiri kubha okugwaata obhusaani ne ekyaaro, ni kubha omubhisa wa Taatabhugya? Kweego, wowoosi wuno akweenda kugwaatana obhusaani ne ekyaaro, arabha omubhisa wa Taatabhugya.
Ambe! Mutiiseega kubha ekaamirwe bhusa mu Makaamo Amahoreeru kubha, Ekoro yino Taatabhugya atutuuriiri muusi weetu ane eriihari bhukongʼu.
Nawe, aratwoongererya orubhaango, nikyo ekaamirwe mu Makaamo Amahoreeru,
Kweego, mubhe muramwiigwa Taatabhugya. Nawe Seetaani, mubhe muramwaanga, niho araabhangʼose.
Mubhe muramwiisukiirira Taatabhugya, niho woosi, araabhiisukiirire. Emwe bhe ebhibhi, mute ebhibhi bhyeenyu no okukora amazomu, emwe bha amiiseego abhiri, mumutuniirire kwe eziikoro zyeenyu zyoosi.
Mwiigwe obhururu, murire no okwaaramira. Ekiseko kyeenyu, kiikyoore okurira, no obhuzomererwa bhweenyu, bhwiikyoore obhururu.
Mwiiyiikye iyaasi embere wo Omukuru, neewe arabhatiirya.
Mutabha muramoonyana

Abhahiiri bhaane, mutabha muriitaamirirya, kwo okubha, wowoosi wuno akwiitaamirirya iguru wo omurikyaaye, kasi okumutinira emigiro, niho akubha agiitaamiriirye emigiro gya Taatabhugya. Na hano okutinira ekiina emigiro, eno otari omukori we emigiro, orabha obheeri omutini we ekiina.
Taatabhugya omweene, niwe akutuura emigiro, na niwe omutaania waazo. Niwe aranagya okutuurya no okusikya. Nawe awe ni weewi, naabhe oramutinira omunyaroobho waazo emigiro?
Mutabha muriikumya kugano mukyaari kubha nago
Bhoono, muniitegeerere kisi, bhano mukubhuga, “Reero kasi izo, turaaza kugya orugeendo mumugye omurebhe. Na turiikara eyo mwaaka mugima, turasuruzya no okubhona obhweera.”
Ndora mutamenyiri gano garaabhoneke izo! Obhwiikari bhwaazo niki? Ndora ni kye eryooki, rirarorekana kwiibhaga isuuhu, rugeendo rumwe rirabhura!
Mureenderwa, mubhe murabhuga, “Kyeego Omukuru akweenda, turabha no obhwiikari na turakora kino kasi kirya.”
Nawe emwe bhoono, muriiyeerekya kubha munabhyo no okwiikumya. No okwiikumya kuyo, ni kubhi.
Kweego, wowoosi wuno amenyiri okukora amazomu nawe atakukora, hayo arakora ebhibhi.

footnotes.text: Ane eriihari bhukongʼu, obhugazuro obhuundi bhuratura kubha, otakutwiigoomba ekireengo kyo okurora eriihari.
